description: Copy chosen pages of a PDF into one new PDF, in the order listed. Page numbers start at 1 (the check tools return 0-based `page` values: add 1). Writes a NEW .pdf inside the allowed folder and never changes or overwrites an existing file. Pages are an array of numbers and ranges; a page may not be listed twice. Bookmarks to kept pages, metadata and form fields on kept pages are kept; layers and static XFA are dropped (listed in `lost`). Digital signatures are removed. A dynamic XFA form or an encrypted PDF is refused. Example: {"pdfPath":"report.pdf","pages":[1,"3-5"],"outputPath":"report-part.pdf"}. This is not redaction and does not sanitise: pages you leave out are not copied, but document metadata, bookmark titles and anything a kept page shares with an omitted page can remain. Use redact_pdf to remove sensitive content. Nothing is uploaded.

outputPath.description: new .pdf to create; must not exist

pages.description: pages to keep, 1-based, in output order

items.description: A page number like 3 or a range like "2-5". A bare-number string ("5"), a leading zero, a reversed range and a repeated page are refused.

pdfPath.description: path to the PDF, inside the allowed folder

name: extract_pages
title: Extract pages
